summary: T-0689 (P1 from T-0686 live-proof / capstone T-0647, wave 5): apply the T-0686 «Название→auto-ключ» inversion to collection COLUMNS (sub-fields), and fix two T-0686 preview cosmetics (FU-1, FU-2). WHERE THE COLUMN REQUIRED A KEY: CollectionSubFieldEditor (screen-app-schema.jsx) rendered a MANDATORY first-column mono 'Ключ' input ('col_key') with «Название» marked '(опц.)', and validateField's collection branch errored 'Укажите ключ колонки' on an empty column key — the same field-level «слаг-ад» one nesting level down. WHAT WAS INVERTED: «Название» (the column `label`) is now PRIMARY + first, widest column; the machine column KEY auto-derives from it and is shown SlugField-style («ключ: X · изменить», new SubFieldKeyPreview) in the column's sub-row, optionally hand-editable. REUSE OF T-0686 HELPERS (no new derivation grammar): the new withAutoSubFieldKeys calls the EXISTING deriveFieldKeyFromTitle (snake_case FIELD_KEY_RE, reused verbatim — same T-0650 transliterate under the hood) + the EXISTING uniqueFieldKey for collision suffixing. UNIQUENESS IS WITHIN THE COLLECTION: column keys are property names inside ONE items.properties object, so withAutoSubFieldKeys dedups (base, base_2) within that collection only (not the whole set). STABLE-KEY INVARIANT (critical — a column key is a property name inside the collection sub-schema; changing it orphans every stored row's cell): withAutoSubFieldKeys fills ONLY empty column keys — a keyed column (loaded via parseRecordSchema, or hand-keyed) is never re-derived, so renaming a column's «Название» never moves its key. Applied only to NEW columns (mirror of T-0686 withAutoFieldKeys). FU-1 (preview collision lie): the old per-field preview uniquified each field against a FLAT set of all other fields' derived keys, so two unsaved same-named fields/columns BOTH previewed base_2; replaced with previewAutoKeyAt / previewAutoSubKeyAt — the ORDERED withAutoFieldKeys / withAutoSubFieldKeys pass read at the field's index, so the preview now equals exactly the key buildRecordSchema will save (first=base, second=base_2). FU-2 (loaded-field preview re-derives): parseRecordSchema now stamps keyTouched:true on every parsed top-level field and subKeyTouched:true on every parsed column, so the editor SHOWS the persisted key instead of re-deriving it from the loaded title/label (data was always correct — save never changed the key; only the PREVIEW lied).
deviations_from_adr: No separate ADR/spec authored — small UX-inversion task explicitly scoped to REUSE the T-0686 pattern one level down (per task brief 'реюз T-0686, НЕ выдумывай'). Design decisions documented inline in code comments (apps-schema.js withAutoSubFieldKeys/previewAutoKeyAt/previewAutoSubKeyAt headers + screen-app-schema.jsx SubFieldKeyPreview header) and in this handoff.

FU-1 fix centralized the preview derivation into two new exported pure helpers (previewAutoKeyAt / previewAutoSubKeyAt) that run the ORDERED withAuto*Keys pass, rather than patching the old per-sibling flat-set computation in place. This makes preview==save a structural guarantee (single source of truth = the same withAuto*Keys the build uses) and removed the JSX-side siblingKeys prop plumbing entirely.
friction_events: CLIENT-ONLY confirmation (the load-bearing scoping finding): a collection COLUMN key is NOT a server-addressable entity — it is a JSON property name inside items.properties of the record_schema, which is submitted WHOLE via POST/PUT /api/registry-defs and validated by the server's AJV (unchanged). So the entire inversion + dedup lives in the pure client module apps-schema.js (buildRecordSchema/withAutoSubFieldKeys), gated by backendAccepts() (the real AJV strict) on every new pin. No server/DB/migration delta → fitness:db correctly not run (honestly marked, per D-064 Docker-honesty note: there is nothing server-side to gate here).
